title: Bug: Nexthop platform shows Unknown reboot cause when docker restart
author: lotus-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

broadcom

### Importance or Severity

Low

### Description of the bug

Restarting `determine-reboot-cause` can cause `show reboot-cause history` to show unknown entries due to the reload cause service running again and attempting to read from hardware an already cleared black box.

### Steps to Reproduce

Before fix:
```
admin@humm302:~$ show reboot-cause history
Name                 Cause                                                                                       Time                             User    Comment
-------------------  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  -------------------------------  ------  ---------------------------------------------------------------------
2026_04_26_19_41_31  reboot                                                                                      Sun Apr 26 07:39:05 PM UTC 2026  admin   N/A
...

admin@humm302:~$ sudo systemctl restart database.service

admin@humm302:~$ show reboot-cause history
Name                 Cause                                                                                       Time                             User    Comment
-------------------  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  -------------------------------  ------  ---------------------------------------------------------------------
2026_04_26_19_55_46  Unknown                                                                                     N/A                              N/A     Unknown
2026_04_26_19_41_31  reboot                                                                                      Sun Apr 26 07:39:05 PM UTC 2026  admin   N/A
...
```

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Expect behavior:
```
admin@humm302:~$ show reboot-cause history
Name                 Cause                                                                                       Time                             User    Comment
-------------------  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  -------------------------------  ------  ---------------------------------------------------------------------
2026_04_26_20_02_51  reboot                                                                                      Sun Apr 26 08:00:27 PM UTC 2026  admin   N/A
...

admin@humm302:~$ sudo systemctl restart database.service
admin@humm302:~$ show reboot-cause history
Name                 Cause                                                                                       Time                             User    Comment
-------------------  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  -------------------------------  ------  ---------------------------------------------------------------------
2026_04_26_20_02_51  reboot                                                                                      Sun Apr 26 08:00:27 PM UTC 2026  admin   N/A
...
```

#### Why I did it
Fixes #26996 

When `determine-reboot-cause` is run on Nexthop products, the reboot cause is retrieved from a hardware blackbox, and the the hardware blackbox is cleared.

In this PR we add a check to prevent `determine-reboot-cause` from running twice, because the second run causes us to attempt to retrieve the reboot cause from an already cleared hardware blackbox.

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it

Add a guard to prevent subsequent runs of `determine-reboot-cause`

#### How to verify it

Before fix:
```
admin@humm302:~$ show reboot-cause history
Name                 Cause                                                                                       Time                             User    Comment
-------------------  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  -------------------------------  ------  ---------------------------------------------------------------------

...

admin@humm302:~$ sudo systemctl restart database.service

admin@humm302:~$ show reboot-cause history
Name                 Cause                                                                                       Time                             User    Comment
-------------------  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  -------------------------------  ------  ---------------------------------------------------------------------
2026_04_26_19_55_46  Unknown                                                                                     N/A                              N/A     Unknown
2026_04_26_19_41_31  reboot                                                                                      Sun Apr 26 07:39:05 PM UTC 2026  admin   N/A
...
```

After fix:
```
admin@humm302:~$ show reboot-cause history
Name                 Cause                                                                                       Time                             User    Comment

admin@humm302:~$ show reboot-cause history

-------------------  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  -------------------------------  ------  ---------------------------------------------------------------------
2026_04_26_20_02_51  reboot                                                                                      Sun Apr 26 08:00:27 PM UTC 2026  admin   N/A
...
```
